usageScope.description: observed keeps counters since attach/reset; session additionally builds the optional full-session ledger (reads full history once per baseline; status-marked in the HUD)

showSpeed.description: show the spd* field: average generation speed of the last completed assistant message (provider-reported tokens over the first-token-to-end window)

quota.description: Optional provider quota support. Default off: with enabled=false no credentials are parsed and no network/subprocess tasks exist. Credentials are never stored here; the host resolves the current provider key at query time. Implemented adapters: zai (GLM personal-legacy and team query modes, region cn), deepseek and siliconflow (official balance endpoints, Bearer auth), codex (app-server subprocess source: a short-lived `codex app-server` child performs a read-only account/rateLimits/read using the local codex login; requires the codex CLI on PATH; no Pi credential is read). Other adapter names are accepted for configuration diagnostics and report unsupported-adapter without any request. Balance adapters refuse a provider whose resolved base URL is a different origin (needs-verification); relay keys are never sent to the official hosts.

ttlMs.description: Cache lifetime. Expiry never triggers network access; the next event refreshes.

profiles.description: Quota identities. Organization/project values are account context, not credentials; keep them out of shared/repo configurations.

providerId.description: Exact Pi provider id; never matched by prefix.

region.description: Required for zai/minimax. global stays unverified for GLM and reports needs-verification without requests.

queryMode.description: personal-legacy and team are account-verified. The type=1 `personal` candidate was dropped from scope (owner decision 2026-09-22) and is rejected at load.

modelIds.description: Optional exact model ids narrowing this profile within the provider.

origin.description: Optional constraint that must equal the adapter's fixed origin (zai cn: https://open.bigmodel.cn; deepseek: https://api.deepseek.com; siliconflow: https://api.siliconflow.cn).
